14.17.title: Doppler Radar - Doppler Filter Bandwidth
14.17.title_cn: 多普勒雷达 - 多普勒滤波器通带宽度
14.17.description: A Doppler radar operates at 12 GHz and is used to detect targets with velocity range 1-20 m/s. Calculate the Doppler frequency shifts and the required filter bandwidth.
14.17.description_cn: 多普勒雷达工作频率12 GHz，用于探测速度为1-20 m/s的目标，求多普勒频移及滤波器所需通带宽度。

f0.description: Radar carrier frequency (雷达载波频率)

v_min.description: Minimum target velocity (最小目标速度)

v_max.description: Maximum target velocity (最大目标速度)

steps.title: Calculate Wavelength
steps.explanation: Wavelength equals speed of light divided by carrier frequency.
steps.explanation_cn: 波长等于光速除以载波频率。

steps.title: Doppler Shift Formula
steps.explanation: The Doppler frequency shift for a radar signal reflected from a moving target is twice the target velocity divided by the wavelength. The factor of 2 accounts for the round-trip path.
steps.explanation_cn: 雷达信号从运动目标反射时的多普勒频移等于目标速度的两倍除以波长。系数2是因为信号往返路径。

steps.title: Calculate Minimum Doppler Shift
steps.explanation: At minimum target velocity v=1 m/s, the Doppler shift is 80 Hz.
steps.explanation_cn: 当目标速度 v=1 m/s 时，多普勒频移为 80 Hz。

steps.title: Calculate Maximum Doppler Shift
steps.explanation: At maximum target velocity v=20 m/s, the Doppler shift is 1600 Hz.
steps.explanation_cn: 当目标速度 v=20 m/s 时，多普勒频移为 1600 Hz。

steps.title: Determine Filter Bandwidth
steps.explanation: The required Doppler filter bandwidth covers the range from minimum to maximum Doppler shift.
steps.explanation_cn: 多普勒滤波器所需带宽覆盖最小到最大多普勒频移的范围。

key_concepts_cn: 雷达系统中的多普勒效应
